name: jumper
title: Jumper
description: Jump back and forward through recently used apps, like browser history.
author: matt_herwig

commands.name: go-back
commands.title: Jump Back to Previous App
commands.subtitle: Jumper
commands.description: Switch to the app you used before this one. Run again to keep going back. Best bound to a hotkey.

commands.name: go-forward
commands.title: Jump Forward to Next App
commands.subtitle: Jumper
commands.description: Retrace a Jump Back step. Best bound to a hotkey.

commands.name: show-app-history
commands.title: Show App History
commands.subtitle: Jumper
commands.description: List running apps from most to least recently used and jump to any of them.

scripts.check: npm run test && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
